if.test: decision != null and decision != '' and decision != 'UNDECIDED'

mapper.select:
select q.*, d.decision as decision, d.comment as decision_comment, d.reviewer as reviewer, d.reviewed_at as reviewed_at, d.updated_at as decision_updated_at from ( select concat('TABLE_NO_ROWS:', t.id) as issue_key, 'TABLE_NO_ROWS' as issue_type, 'HIGH' as severity, t.side as side, t.note_no as note_no, n.note_name as note_name, t.id as table_id, t.table_title as table_title, 'table' as level, t.id as ref_id, coalesce(nullif(t.table_title, ''), '未命名表') as ref_text, 1 as expected_count, 0 as actual_count, concat('表没有识别出任何行：', coalesce(nullif(t.table_title, ''), '未命名表')) as message, '优先打开原始 PDF/Excel 核对：这张表是否真的没有行；如果有行，说明原文件结构解析漏掉了行轴。' as suggestion, t.source_locator as locator from structure_table t left join structure_note n on n.project_id = t.project_id and n.side = t.side and n.note_no = t.note_no left join ( select table_id, count(*) as row_count from structure_row where project_id = #{projectId} group by table_id ) r on r.table_id = t.id where t.project_id = #{projectId} and coalesce(r.row_count, 0) = 0
union all
select concat('TABLE_NO_COLUMNS:', t.id) as issue_key, 'TABLE_NO_COLUMNS' as issue_type, 'HIGH' as severity, t.side as side, t.note_no as note_no, n.note_name as note_name, t.id as table_id, t.table_title as table_title, 'table' as level, t.id as ref_id, coalesce(nullif(t.table_title, ''), '未命名表') as ref_text, 1 as expected_count, 0 as actual_count, concat('表没有识别出任何列：', coalesce(nullif(t.table_title, ''), '未命名表')) as message, '优先打开原始 PDF/Excel 核对：这张表是否真的没有列；如果有列，说明原文件结构解析漏掉了列轴。' as suggestion, t.source_locator as locator from structure_table t left join structure_note n on n.project_id = t.project_id and n.side = t.side and n.note_no = t.note_no left join ( select table_id, count(*) as column_count from structure_column where project_id = #{projectId} group by table_id ) c on c.table_id = t.id where t.project_id = #{projectId} and coalesce(c.column_count, 0) = 0
union all
select concat('TABLE_NO_CELLS:', t.id) as issue_key, 'TABLE_NO_CELLS' as issue_type, 'HIGH' as severity, t.side as side, t.note_no as note_no, n.note_name as note_name, t.id as table_id, t.table_title as table_title, 'table' as level, t.id as ref_id, coalesce(nullif(t.table_title, ''), '未命名表') as ref_text, 1 as expected_count, 0 as actual_count, concat('表有标题但没有识别出任何单元格：', coalesce(nullif(t.table_title, ''), '未命名表')) as message, '如果原表实际有数据，这通常说明表格区域、黄标区域或单元格抽取失败；需要先修正原文件结构识别结果。' as suggestion, t.source_locator as locator from structure_table t left join structure_note n on n.project_id = t.project_id and n.side = t.side and n.note_no = t.note_no left join ( select table_id, count(*) as cell_count from structure_cell where project_id = #{projectId} group by table_id ) cell on cell.table_id = t.id where t.project_id = #{projectId} and coalesce(cell.cell_count, 0) = 0
union all
select concat('CELL_COUNT_MISMATCH:', s.table_id) as issue_key, 'CELL_COUNT_MISMATCH' as issue_type, case when s.cell_count < s.row_count * s.column_count then 'HIGH' else 'MEDIUM' end as severity, s.side as side, s.note_no as note_no, n.note_name as note_name, s.table_id as table_id, s.table_title as table_title, 'table' as level, s.table_id as ref_id, coalesce(nullif(s.table_title, ''), '未命名表') as ref_text, s.row_count * s.column_count as expected_count, s.cell_count as actual_count, concat( '表的行列组合数和单元格数不一致：预计 ', s.row_count * s.column_count, ' 个，实际 ', s.cell_count, ' 个。' ) as message, '先核对这张表的行轴、列轴是否被拆错；如果行列轴正确，再核对是否漏识别或重复识别了单元格。' as suggestion, s.source_locator as locator from ( select t.id as table_id, t.project_id, t.side, t.note_no, t.table_title, t.source_locator, coalesce(r.row_count, 0) as row_count, coalesce(c.column_count, 0) as column_count, coalesce(cell.cell_count, 0) as cell_count from structure_table t left join ( select table_id, count(*) as row_count from structure_row where project_id = #{projectId} group by table_id ) r on r.table_id = t.id left join ( select table_id, count(*) as column_count from structure_column where project_id = #{projectId} group by table_id ) c on c.table_id = t.id left join ( select table_id, count(*) as cell_count from structure_cell where project_id = #{projectId} group by table_id ) cell on cell.table_id = t.id where t.project_id = #{projectId} ) s left join structure_note n on n.project_id = s.project_id and n.side = s.side and n.note_no = s.note_no where s.row_count > 0 and s.column_count > 0 and s.cell_count != s.row_count * s.column_count
union all
select concat('EMPTY_ROW_KEY:', r.id) as issue_key, 'EMPTY_ROW_KEY' as issue_type, 'HIGH' as severity, r.side as side, r.note_no as note_no, n.note_name as note_name, r.table_id as table_id, r.table_title as table_title, 'row' as level, r.id as ref_id, coalesce(nullif(r.row_path, ''), nullif(r.row_leaf, ''), '空行名') as ref_text, 1 as expected_count, 0 as actual_count, concat('行没有可用于匹配的 row_key：', coalesce(nullif(r.row_path, ''), nullif(r.row_leaf, ''), '空行名')) as message, 'row_key 为空会影响 PDF/Excel 对齐和 runtime 覆盖判断；需要核对这行是否是空行、层级标题，还是解析漏了行名。' as suggestion, r.source_locator as locator from structure_row r left join structure_note n on n.project_id = r.project_id and n.side = r.side and n.note_no = r.note_no where r.project_id = #{projectId} and trim(coalesce(r.row_key, '')) = ''
union all
select concat('EMPTY_COLUMN_KEY:', c.id) as issue_key, 'EMPTY_COLUMN_KEY' as issue_type, 'HIGH' as severity, c.side as side, c.note_no as note_no, n.note_name as note_name, c.table_id as table_id, c.table_title as table_title, 'column' as level, c.id as ref_id, coalesce(nullif(c.column_path, ''), nullif(c.column_leaf, ''), '空列名') as ref_text, 1 as expected_count, 0 as actual_count, concat('列没有可用于匹配的 column_key：', coalesce(nullif(c.column_path, ''), nullif(c.column_leaf, ''), '空列名')) as message, 'column_key 为空会影响 PDF/Excel 对齐和 runtime 覆盖判断；需要核对这列是否是空列、合并表头，还是解析漏了列名。' as suggestion, c.source_locator as locator from structure_column c left join structure_note n on n.project_id = c.project_id and n.side = c.side and n.note_no = c.note_no where c.project_id = #{projectId} and trim(coalesce(c.column_key, '')) = ''
union all
select concat('CELL_WITHOUT_ROW_OR_COLUMN:', cell.id) as issue_key, 'CELL_WITHOUT_ROW_OR_COLUMN' as issue_type, 'HIGH' as severity, cell.side as side, cell.note_no as note_no, n.note_name as note_name, cell.table_id as table_id, cell.table_title as table_title, 'cell' as level, cell.id as ref_id, concat( '行=', coalesce(nullif(cell.row_path, ''), nullif(cell.row_key, ''), '空'), '；列=', coalesce(nullif(cell.column_path, ''), nullif(cell.column_key, ''), '空'), '；值=', coalesce(nullif(cell.value_text, ''), nullif(cell.normalized_value, ''), '空') ) as ref_text, 2 as expected_count, case when trim(coalesce(cell.row_key, '')) = '' and trim(coalesce(cell.column_key, '')) = '' then 0 else 1 end as actual_count, concat( '单元格缺少行名或列名：行=', coalesce(nullif(cell.row_path, ''), nullif(cell.row_key, ''), '空'), '，列=', coalesce(nullif(cell.column_path, ''), nullif(cell.column_key, ''), '空') ) as message, '单元格必须能落到明确的行和列；否则它不能稳定生成结构GT，也不能稳定和 runtime 结果匹配。' as suggestion, cell.source_locator as locator from structure_cell cell left join structure_note n on n.project_id = cell.project_id and n.side = cell.side and n.note_no = cell.note_no where cell.project_id = #{projectId} and (trim(coalesce(cell.row_key, '')) = '' or trim(coalesce(cell.column_key, '')) = '')
union all
select concat('EMPTY_LOCATOR:ROW:', r.id) as issue_key, 'EMPTY_LOCATOR' as issue_type, 'MEDIUM' as severity, r.side as side, r.note_no as note_no, n.note_name as note_name, r.table_id as table_id, r.table_title as table_title, 'row' as level, r.id as ref_id, coalesce(nullif(r.row_path, ''), nullif(r.row_leaf, ''), nullif(r.row_key, ''), '空行名') as ref_text, 1 as expected_count, 0 as actual_count, '行结构没有原文件定位。' as message, '如果要把原文件结构作为结构GT，建议补齐定位，至少能回到 Excel sheet/单元格或 PDF 页码/区域。' as suggestion, r.source_locator as locator from structure_row r left join structure_note n on n.project_id = r.project_id and n.side = r.side and n.note_no = r.note_no where r.project_id = #{projectId} and trim(coalesce(r.source_locator, '')) = ''
union all
select concat('EMPTY_LOCATOR:COLUMN:', c.id) as issue_key, 'EMPTY_LOCATOR' as issue_type, 'MEDIUM' as severity, c.side as side, c.note_no as note_no, n.note_name as note_name, c.table_id as table_id, c.table_title as table_title, 'column' as level, c.id as ref_id, coalesce(nullif(c.column_path, ''), nullif(c.column_leaf, ''), nullif(c.column_key, ''), '空列名') as ref_text, 1 as expected_count, 0 as actual_count, '列结构没有原文件定位。' as message, '如果要把原文件结构作为结构GT，建议补齐定位，至少能回到 Excel sheet/单元格或 PDF 页码/区域。' as suggestion, c.source_locator as locator from structure_column c left join structure_note n on n.project_id = c.project_id and n.side = c.side and n.note_no = c.note_no where c.project_id = #{projectId} and trim(coalesce(c.source_locator, '')) = ''
union all
select concat('EMPTY_LOCATOR:CELL:', cell.id) as issue_key, 'EMPTY_LOCATOR' as issue_type, 'LOW' as severity, cell.side as side, cell.note_no as note_no, n.note_name as note_name, cell.table_id as table_id, cell.table_title as table_title, 'cell' as level, cell.id as ref_id, concat( '行=', coalesce(nullif(cell.row_path, ''), nullif(cell.row_key, ''), '空'), '；列=', coalesce(nullif(cell.column_path, ''), nullif(cell.column_key, ''), '空'), '；值=', coalesce(nullif(cell.value_text, ''), nullif(cell.normalized_value, ''), '空') ) as ref_text, 1 as expected_count, 0 as actual_count, '单元格没有原文件定位。' as message, '低优先级：如果行列和值都明确，可以先使用；冻结为结构GT前最好补齐定位证据。' as suggestion, cell.source_locator as locator from structure_cell cell left join structure_note n on n.project_id = cell.project_id and n.side = cell.side and n.note_no = cell.note_no where cell.project_id = #{projectId} and trim(coalesce(cell.source_locator, '')) = '' ) q left join structure_quality_decision d on d.project_id = #{projectId} and d.issue_key = q.issue_key where 1 = 1
order by case q.severity when 'HIGH' then 1 when 'MEDIUM' then 2 else 3 end, case when q.note_no regexp '^[0-9]+$' then cast(q.note_no as unsigned) else 999999 end, q.note_no, q.side, q.table_id, case q.level when 'table' then 1 when 'row' then 2 when 'column' then 3 else 4 end, q.ref_id
